failed_approaches: The first final-suite attempt exposed and corrected a missing public migration-history mapping in a historical fixture.

The corrected full-suite rerun used stable postgres admin connections and the authorized disposable vulgata database, but exposed one independent fingerprint mismatch and two PostgreSQL timeout paths.
approved_changed_approach: Use one bounded evidence-driven cycle without changing Story 18.1 production code: isolate the fingerprint test and determine the authoritative resource/fingerprint; inspect PostgreSQL health and run the two timeout cases serially against fresh owned databases; correct only an evidenced fixture or accepted-artifact defect; then rerun affected tests and the exact full suite.
limits: This raises the cumulative pause limit from 6 to 7. It does not reset the counter or authorize seven additional failures. A negative result at count 7 returns to the human.
unchanged_gates: Definition authority, accepted scope, database/resource authorization, convergence, lookback, independent quality review, conditional E2E, final verification and closure remain required.
summary: The user approved the finite Story 18.1 recovery extension from six to seven failed results for the three configured full-suite failures recorded in verify-test-failure-03.
